name: Einkorn Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies (Half Batch)
ingredients:
6 tbsp butter
1/2 cup brown sugar
2 tbsp white sugar
1 large egg (optionally tip out about 1 tbsp of the white)
1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup Bluebird einkorn flour
Heaping 1/4 tsp baking soda (3/8 tsp)
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup chocolate chips
1/3 cup unsweetened coconut flakes, toasted (optional)
Flaky salt, for topping
directions:
1. If using coconut, toast it at 350°F for 4-6 minutes, stirring once, until golden. Let cool.
2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Let it boil, then foam, then keep stirring until it turns light brown and smells nutty. Cool about 10 minutes, until warm but not hot.
3. In a large bowl, mix the browned butter, brown sugar, and white sugar until just combined.
4. Add the egg and vanilla and mix until just combined.
5. Add the flour, baking soda, and salt. Mix until just combined; do not overmix.
6. Fold in the chocolate chips and coconut.
7. Scoop into 2-inch balls and place on a baking sheet. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes; overnight is better.
8. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Top each ball with a pinch of flaky salt.
9. Bake 9-11 minutes, until the edges are set and the centers still look slightly underdone.
10. Cool on the sheet 5 minutes, then move to a wire rack.
description: Half batch of Bluebird Grain Farms' einkorn chocolate chip cookie: browned butter, extra yolk richness, optional toasted coconut, and a longer chill for less spread.
notes:
A whole egg gives slightly puffier, cakier cookies. Tipping out about 1 tbsp of the white matches the original recipe's chewier texture.

Frozen einkorn flour can go straight into the dough without thawing.

Full batch: double everything except the egg, which becomes 1 egg plus 1 yolk.
